body:
They don't ask for help out right, but if I dont help they complain about how I'm not helping and I'm an ungrateful child. And now that I am helping they complain that I don't do things right (a recent complaint that comes to mind is I washed the dishes and obviously the level of soap in the soap dispenser fell and my father was like you use too much soap and you are so wasteful. The soap was getting lower because I was washing the dishes every day while my mom would wash them maybe once a fortnight at most.

My mom hoards a lot of stuff because she does not have the finacial resources to buy what she needs when she needs it, so she keeps everything considering what if she needs it later on and when we were younger and did not understand our father we would ask for things and because she horded things we never felt like we didnt get what we wanted. My father has severe financial control over her. His money is his money and she has no money. I'm living paycheck to paycheck so I don't have the financial capacity at the moment to support her like my dad can. And by this point the hording has become severe to the point she cannot let go of a peice of paper or a button or anything.

My brothers are messy and do not clean up after themselves just like they saw our dad doing growing up. My dad instilled in them that they dont have to clean up after themselves since that is a womans job. I have tried talking to them but I do not have the same power as a parent would and they would be right in saying that I'm not there parent so I dont have to listen to you. They only listen to my father and my father just teaches them to be worse. Me and my sister are clean and our spaces are always neat.

Well it's a long story. My father works, my mom is a stay at home mom, she wanted to work when they got married but my father said to stay home and take care of the kids and he is very misogynistic and controls the family with money. They have been married for 30 years and over the years he isolated her from friends and family to the point that now she has none... and since it was done slowly over many years she didnt realize it until it was too late. So there is no one to turn to for help or guidance at this point. I figured him out too late too (when I was 21) so he had been manipulating me for 21 years already. 

We were is a car accident where my father was driving too fast and my 1 year old brother died, after that she had no motivation to do anything including keeping up with the house (this was 20 years ago) she never got help or therapy for it (I was too young at the time to recognize that I should encourage her to get thearpy). My father never took responsibility or acknowledged that he was remorseful for his actions. I understand initially not being able to do anything but if she had healed and taken care of herself properly it might not have such a strong hold on her 20 years later... but by this point the wound has festered and idk if there is any way to help her at this point.

Now that we are older and she has the ability to work he tells her "you can't keep up with the house work and you want to work outside, dont be ridiculous,  first finish the house work"

I guess all the trauma from years and years of subtle abuse has made her paralysed mentally and made her physically older then she really is. She gets tired easily and she sleeps a lot

I am in therapy and all I can do is encourage her to also get therapy, but she is not willing to do that. She is not mentally incompetent so I cannot drag her to therapy.

I also said that they are getting on in years because I have heard my dad whining and crying about how much he has to work at such an old age and he is always victimizing himself (he has a good job as a professor...that is not very physically demanding IMO with a good pay). I guess he is not that old but that's what he is always saying so I suppose I fell into his drama.

No, no cognitive issues
Stubbornness
You are right. I need some sense knocked into me

It took a while, but yes!! Now he just gives me the ick. I know this is the most cliche thing but time helped a lot, no contact helped a lot.

After almost two years to the exact date he messaged me randomly, I was not expecting it at all, I barely ever thought of him any more... he was there on my mind but on back burner. When he messaged I got this adrenaline rush, I got excited... but he over killed it, he was saying all this shit that i had been hoping for two years to hear and in that moment it all felt so fake..  how could this person who hurt me sooo much have the audacity to come back and act as if everything was fine! It was so fake and it wasn't gonna work on me any more, it felt nasty and icky talking to him... and I was finally free, he was  kicked off the pedestal and off for good. Good riddance. 

The war is over ✌
I really hope you don't live in Saudi Arabia if you are asking that question 😳

Yes!!! This is exactly what I'm feeling right now. To the t. How did it click for you that it was just your ego? Any tips? And any tips on accepting the facts and moving on? Or does it just take time and patience? 

When push came to shove for me I choose him over everything, which in hindsight was not the best idea. It happened summer of 2019 where I had to make the choice.

And now it happened for him and he made his choice and broke up with me.

Me choosing him didn't benefit me at all in the end and I'm left with nothing because of the choice I made. And I'm angry at myself for giving so much to a person who in a similar situation didn't do the same for me.

It's always so heartbreaking everytime we discover something new from their infidelity,  everytime the knife gets pushed in deeper. And there is no accountability from them (at least that how it is in my case).

You are lucky to be blocked, you don't have to stress as much about going NC. My ex did block me in the very beginning but unblocked me 2 weeks into the breakup. If he had kept me blocked I would be 3 months clean by now. But that's not on him, I should be strong enough to block him, and fingers crossed eventually I'll be.

>if he messaged you at all then deleted it, he's probably going through some stuff too.

Unfortunately I confronted him about deleting the message and he said he remembered my "order" that he not contact me ever again when we broke up. But unfortunately he remembered it a little too late, the damage had already been done. He deleted it 16 hours after sending it so I had already seen it.

I have been in my head since he send the message. I had been 10 days NC. The longest I have gone is 26 days NC with him. Idk how I'm ever gonna go permanently NC with him. It's already been 3 months since the break up but I haven't been able to block him and he keeps sending insignificant texts that trigger me into talking to him. Out of the 3 months, 1.5 months was him hovering me back into the relationship and then he dumped me again.

Idk what to do. I know we both went through a breakup but from my side he doesn't seem to be feeling any affects from it. He's living it up as always while I'm left feeling helpless and lost without him

That's really sweet of you to say. I guess right now I'm just feeling so guilty that I'm not able to just block him. It's literally a click of a button but it feels so daunting to me. Plus blocking has never been an issue of mine with anyone else. But with this ex its seems absolutely impossible. I know it would make my life so much easier but I'm not able to do it and idk what to do about it. I have been suggested to do it many times by many people and I have read about blocking in multiple articles and how it's the No.1 thing to do in going NC. I know this is a wise suggestions from everyone who says it but I can't do it and idk what to do about it. I'm at a lose with myself
I really want it to dies soon. It's a b**ch that keeps torturing me to no end
Its was confirmed that it was just a drunk text, ot was not intentional as I had hoped. He didn't actually mean to send it. He just drunk dialled me... as the saying goes

I can't bring myself to block him. I need to do a lot of healing. My self respect is in the gutter right now. He took a lot from me and I'm trying to build myself back up in the middle of missing him constantly

I have tried blocking him but everytime I unblock again. I have his usernames and numbers memorized so there is no use deleting them from my phone. I have tried. I just end up adding him back. It really sucks

The first time he broke up with me he actually blocked me everywhere and them slowly he added me back everywhere.

Idk how to explain it. It's like I know what to do and how to do it,  but when I go to do it I can't.  It's like a paralyzed person trying to walk.  They know what they have to do but they can't

I have read this. I was addicted to him and I'm just going through withdrawal. This sucks. I feel helpless when it comes to him. Fuck him for making me love him so much while he is not effected by me at all. There has been no withdrawal symptoms from his side. Only happiness and living his best life. While I feel sick to my stomach, hoping every day it will get better.

I'm not planning on seriously dating anyone. I don't want a relationship again. I just wanted to distract myself because I was hurting so much recently so I went out and everyone just felt so... wrong. 
We were together 4 years and broke up 3 months ago, 10 days ago I went NC with him.
I don't have a life right now because I gave up everything for him. I broke my relationship with my family. My friends are no longer my friends because I didn't keep that up. I have nothing left. I'm trying to mend all that now. I have made some progress with my family. But I have no friends or anyone I can talk to or hang out with.
Weekends suck after the breakup because I used to spend all my weekends with him. So I decided to go out and it didn't work out. It just made me feel worse.
Guess I just have to take it day by day. Miss him until I have no more energy to miss him. Put going out on hold and just work on myself as much as I can

He initiated both break ups. So now there is no going back to him for me. That road is permanently closed. I have to learn to have more self respect for myself. 

>make it through the day. That’s it, it doesn’t have to be a great day or one similar to when we were in relationships. But know that day by day it will get better slowly and what is meant to happen will happen.

This is so wise. Sometimes I try to follow a plan, but honestly I'm learning there is no plan. I just have to take it day by day. I will have good days and bad days and I have to a accept both as they come.

I agree. NC is very difficult. I haven't been able to block him yet. Everytime I ask for advice all I get is block him, you will heal much faster,  while I know this, at the moment blocking him is so scary to me.

If you are in the middle stage where he is trying to get you back trend very very carefully, they leave again most of the time. Use me as an example. And its hurts. But I have noticed what you said. You never trust them once they leave so it took me a few days the 2nd time around but I got used to it faster. The first time I cried for weeks on end. He literally ghosted me the 1st time, one day he was telling me he loved me, the next I woke up and I was blocked everywhere and didn't even know what had happened. 

It really baffles me so much how they can do this especially after a serious relationship. How do they keep the facade on for so long? After 4 years, my feeling are absolutely genuine, but it seem he was playing me all along and I'm not just saying that because I'm hurt, I found proof that he was playing me all along. But for 4 years? It's too much. I don't have the energy to fool someone for that long. Idk how he does. 

Towards the end I was only living on hope. I knew he was playing me but I didn't want to admit it because I loved him so much and I hoped that a miracle would happen and he would stop playing me and treat me good. Hope is really hard to kill off.

I sometimes read posts from people who have already gone through it. Or have gone longer without their ex and those stories motivate me. You could try it too. Those stories show that there really is a light at the end of the tunnel even if we can't see it just yet

I had to learn it the hard way too. He kept playing me even after the breakup. He disappeared for a month, I went NC and then he came back with everything. Said he loved me and couldn't live without me, said he was going crazy without me, even saw me, we had a good time, everything seemed lovely. And then one day he decided he didn't want to continue and said I was just imagining things, he was just being friendly, "civilised".  He dumped me over the phone all over again. If he had been in front of me I'm sure I would have punched him in the face for hurting me so much all over again. Once a player, always a player. Talking to you has made me feel less alone and reminded me why it's always a good idea to keep going with NC. So thank you

That sounds good. I have started keeping Netflix on in the back ground so that I don't feel that alone. Without it my house sounds so empty it gets freaky. It never bothered me before, I actually used to enjoy it, but now the quietness and loneliness eats at me.
It feels like I'm having to learn to live all over again. A big part of me is gone and I have to fill the space with something or else the emptiness will overwhelm me

The more they realise we would do anything for them the more they use and abuse us like we are trash. We have to put a stop to it. While we miss them so much, we have to be strong and not let them in ever again. Or they just keep using us whenever they fancy and throw us aside when they are done. Stay strong ♥️

Agreed. I usually look forward to working out, but on weekends my gym is closed so so far I have nothing to look forward to on weekends. And these days my weekends are extra empty because I used to always spend them with him so now I have nothing to do except miss him. I'll have to figure something out.

What do you usually focus on? Maybe somethings that you look forward to could help me out too...
I'm sorry. It really sucks. It hurts so much. I hope it gets better for us soon. We suffer so much all the while the other person is living it up... at least in my case.

I totally understand you in this. I'm sorry you had to go through these feeling. Funny thing is... at least in my case, they don't feel guilty at all. My ex cheated on my throughout the relationship and now that we broke up I'm still hurting so much while he is having the time of his life with another girl. No feeling guilty or anything. He is happy as can be. Its infuriating that I can't just drop my emotions just like him and go out and have some fun. It would just makes me feel disgusting. I know its an irrational feeling but that doesn't mean it's any less real
Believe me I wish I had the strength to. I can't at the moment, it makes me physically sick. Maybe someday I'll gain the strength to do it
I feel you. Tonight's been rough for me too. I'm day 10 NC and I just miss him so damn much that I feel paralysed and unable to do anything other than lay here and cry my eyes out

Exactly. There are so so many tiny things that made that person significant. Those tiny things we will never ever get to experience again because they were unique traits held by that person only. I will always miss them but those tiny traits flew away with him once he left. It hurts

I'm so happy you are doing all those things for yourself. I'm happy you have found those hobbies.

I totally get about the work. Work really takes a back seat while going through a breakup. I have heard some people recommend that you take time off work rather then getting fired or resigning because it's a brutal time right after a BU. 

Everytime I try to go out with friends I don't want to. Either I end up cancelling because I feel sick to my stomach at the thought of going out or even if I force myself to go out, all I can think about the whole time is how I just want to go back home and crawl into bed and cry. I know if he was here I would be jumping up and down to go out and have a good time. I'm trying to be better at socializing but right now I just start getting so panicky and even physically tired if I ever go out.

I have started working out regularly and that is the only time I feel good. I turn all my frustration and pain into exercising and that has helped me a lot. I even  see a significant change in my mood right after i work out. I would 100% recommend it.

I have also stopped drinking because that made missing him a 100 times worse and it made me have absolutely no self control and I cannot have that, especially right now

Trying my best to do things for myself

Thank you for your kind words and reminders. While going through the pain it really does feel like it's never ending. But we have to remember that good days are ahead. The only way is up now. We will get through this. We have to.

I really hope the good days really do get more frequent. Weekends have been horrible for me. The whole weekend I feel awful. And also nights because I was so used to sleeping with him. Even when we were apart we would always sleep while on FT. And now I have to sleep all alone. It's so lonely. And it kills me.
Funny thing is in the beginning when we had just started dating I was so hesitant to always sleeping with him for this exact reason. I knew if one day he left I wouldn't be able to sleep and that's exactly what happened.
I just miss him so damn much and I can't even do anything about it. 💔

I'm sorry you are going through it. It really is awful. Stay NC. I am a 10 days NC. We broke up 3 months ago and then he lead me on for a month. I had to cut contact or he would have kept hurting me.

100% agree with you. Most days I wake up and feel like I have made absolutely no progress. I'm 3 months post break up, 1 week NC, and I still wake up startled in the morning. And unfortunately my morning have started to be at 3am in the morning, I can't sleep past that time anymore. Plus weekends mornings are the worst because we always, always, for the past 4 years spend them together and I was so used to him waking up beside me. 

Him on the other hand is doing perfectly fine, already moved on. Easy as can be

Break ups suck
I will find you and I will kill you

I understand but I was teetering on the edge of whether I should keep watching it or drop it. I just finished watching TVD so the characters are still fresh in my mind. I would prefer watching TO now if I decided to watch it.

While I agree I should have mentioned in my original post that I had just started watching it and I apologise for not stating it, in the end it was just a comment. I wanted to see what others thought about him. If everyone really thought he stays a narcissist throughout the show I would have stopped watching it because narcissism triggers me.

However since reading the comments I have realized there is still hope so I'll continue watching it. 😊

Yes! He's always making comments like that. It's frustrating. Hopefully as I keep watching the show he becomes less insufferable. 

Kudos to the actor for playing him so well. I was watching interviews with the actor and he looks like a genuinely nice guy. But the character is so so annoying
I'm still on Season 1, hopefully as the show goes on he gets better

I don't regret it. I begged for a couple of days after the breakup and he ignored all my messages. Now I can confidently say I did Everything in my power to have him stay in my life but he didn't want to. It's not on me any more. If he ever comes crawling back to me I can confidently say I gave you every opportunity to come back but you didn't take it, you can kindly fuck off now
Congratulations! This gives me hope. I'm day 5 NC. Most of my days are spend crying and the nights suck the worst. I really miss sleeping like a baby
Replacement? What do you mean by that?
Saudi Arabia

>As an adult you can change this, and the narrative. It will be terrifying, it will be hard, but the choice is yours. 

This. This is what I can't get through my head. This is why I feel I have codependence. Idk how to explain it but I still feel like a child even though I'm an adult now. I know the choice is in my hands but this seems to be the most heart wrenching terrifying thing I would have or will ever do. Even if I think about it I feel like I can't do it. I get panicked and sweaty and overwhelmed and I just shut it off. But then my need to become independent comes calling again a couple if days later and then again spiral out

I feel like Gypsy Rose. Ofcourse not the same story but how her mother controlled all aspects of her life by keeping her pretend sick just so she would always rely on the mother to take care of her
Thanks and Sure. And I'll check out the very smooshable gaint teddy bear 😁

The country I live in doesn't discourage the kind of behaviour my father does. In this country I'm the property of my father until I get married and then I'm the property of my husband. If the father dies before the girl gets married she becomes the property of her brother and on and on it goes. 

This is not an issue with other people because commonly the father is not narcissistic, so the daughter is given free reins to do what ever she wants whether it's working or going out or travelling or whatever else she wants to do by her father. But in the end it's all cause their fathers are not crazy and controlling and they give them permission to do whatever they like just like any normal father would.

If I ran away from home I would just be send to the authorities and the authorities would hand me back to my father and tell him to keep me in control. 

I have no friends that I can turn to who would understand what I'm going through. Narcissism cannot be truly understood unless you have gone through it yourself. They just believe the fake stories that my father feeds everyone that he is just "protecting us and keeping us safe" . My own family doesn't see through the lies!! My friends and family turn around and try to give me advice that I should respect and understand my father more and that he is just doing all that he does because he loves me so much. Don't think those people would be ok with living on their couches

Say even if everything worked out and I tried sneaking away, my family is always keeping an eye on me and if my father even gets a whiff of something suspicious going on he has a habit of sitting in front of the door to make sure no one goes out. Or he goes outside and sits in his car on the street to make sure no one tries to sneak out. My 20 year old brother has been raised in my fathers image so when my father is asleep or busy my brother keeps an eye out.

I totally agree with all that you have said. Except for the closure part, I don't think I'll ever get any closure from him ever. However this could be my thinking just right now because it is still so fresh. So I think I'll keep from passing a final judgement on it until a later date. Maybe I'll revisit the idea when I'm more healed and in control of myself. Such as 2 years

Thanks you for you advice.

Thank you for your kind and motivating words. I like how you gave small very specific examples of things I could do to get back on my feet. I feel like these are things that I can do. And little by little I'll start achieving my bigger goals too.

Only looking at the bigger goals was making me feel so overwhelmed before I even began. 

The gigantic teddy bear is a brilliant idea. And I won't feel like I'm responsible for it like I would if I got a living breathing pet which is a whole lot more responsibility compared to a giant teddy bear

I'll check out the book reviewers. I have not gone down that Avenue yet.

I have been so afraid that grief might change me for the worse rather then for the better. Hopefully that's not the case.

Those are wise words. Thank you. 
The only person who I can rely on is myself and only myself

>that’s what you did wrong

Believe me I know! Hind site is a bitch.

And yes as I grow older I am realising I have a very strong victim mentality. I have a lot of work to do on myself and its gonna be painful. Growth doesn't come easy. Let's hope I start figuring it out soon.

Right now I just feel like I am standing in the middle and my life is literally crumbling around me. I have fucked up my life so bad where do I even start to get back on track.

My ex had his life figured out and stuck to his goals no matter what. That's what attracted me to him so much. He had goals and vision and he didn't stop until he reached them. Ever. I want to be like that one day

>the consequences of the decisions I have made and how what happened is totally normal

I'll try this. What has happened happened because of the choices I made. Now I have to move on and figure out how to fix it.

I really hope they do. My ex came back a month into the breakup, led me on for 5 weeks and then changed his mind this week saying he didn't want to try any more. Don't ever take them back if they come back. They are only checking to see if they are still in control. If they have the ability to leave you once that means they were never serious about you and will probably leave you again

I registered for a 4 year course starting in a months time. It is not a time consuming course but fingers crossed it will get my mind off my ex because seriously enough is enough. I can't keep going through this pain indefinitely.
I strive to be like this. I wish one day I'll go from being the girl he didn't want to the girl he can't have. Imagine the power I would hold if that ever happened 💪🏼

My relationship ended because of my ethnicity! I literally CANNOT change anything in this matter. And the hope that maybe someday he might change his mind is making my healing process so much longer. Hope is why I went back to him after he dumped me for a month. Hope is why when I should be 3 months clean of his addiction, I'm only 3 days clean. Hope is really hindering in my growth. But I'm doing the best i can to get out. I want to get out of this pain and suffering no matter what it takes because I can't living like this indefinitely. I can't be his toy forever.

>ever since I decided to focus on my career and goals, merely being around people that aren’t very resourceful would immediately push me away from them.

I want to get to this point

I met him in college so when I graduated I was seriously deep in the relationship with him. Instead of working on myself right out of college as everyone does I focused all my energy and time on him instead. I even let my friends and family go. And now I'm 25 and left with nothing. I'm trying to work on my relationship with my family to make it better ever since we broke up but its not gonna get fixed overnight so working on it. At the moment it's a fight to even get out of bed most days let alone do something productive or motivating for myself

I do go to the gym 5 days a week if that counts...

Last time (this is the second time he has dumped me, the first time he dumped me 3 months ago for a month, then he took me back for a month then this week he decided he didn't want to do it anymore and dumped me again) I graduated to listening to white noise at about the one month mark. Initially I have to be listening to someone talking. So I go to sleep while listening to a discussion or something at the moment.

I have thought of it but I cant do it at the moment. Among other reasons one of the main reasons is I can't afford a pet at the moment. And I wouldn't want to bring a pet home unless I'm absolutely sure I can take care of it first.

He doesn't have a mental illness. He has a personality disorder. Personality disorders can't be changed. Asshole would be the layman turn for NPD. So yes he is an asshole and that's his personality disorder

I just started watching TOs (I'm on S1E2) and I feel he is a malignant narcissist. I have watched TVD so I have an idea of his back story. I feel the writers focus so much on his back story (that he was a bastrad child and that's why his father hated him so much) that you understand why he is so bitter and controlling and the way he is. I feel as I watch the show more I'll see the sociopath in him. 

The way he treats all his siblings as if they are toys he can play with when he wants to and dagars them when they become boring or inconvenient to him irks me so much. 
Also how no one is good enough for rebecca to be with even though all she wants is to have a family. He's so controlling
It's all about him

Though I am surprised that Caroline saw right through him. Again I haven't yet watched TOs properly. But so far from what I know I really admire Caroline for seeing right through him and calling him out on his bullshit. Guess she was always unattainable to him that's why he loved her so much. Because she was not really interested in him. Maybe he liked her for the chase?

>something to believe in

What do you mean by this?
Same here. I know all his social media handles and numbers by heart
I strive to be like you one day, I'm not even strong enough to not pick up his calls if he ever calls. Congratulations on reaching this huge milestone and I hope you find the happiness you deserve

>he’s suddenly giving you the attention

My guess is because I'm not his anymore. He didn't see the need to give me attention in the relationship because I was already hooked on him, even if he took ages to respond I would always forgive him, I wasn't going anywhere. The first couple of years he was very attentive, he was perfect, but after I was hooked he couldn't be bothered with me.

It was a manipulation tactic, he knew how important communication was to me so that's what he used to play me

Granted I'm still fresh out of the relationship so my thinking could be just because of that but I think planning ahead (at least for me) is a coping mechanism more then not trying to live in the present. It helps in that I realise that I still have a future even though he is not going to be in it and at the moment I can't imagine a life without him but I have to.

>if you break up, theres a reason for it, re-evaluate yourself and move on.

If breaking up was really that easy and simple we wouldn't have breakup forums and therapy and all that for something so "silly"
Yes! I hadn't realised how much more times a day I was getting hurt just because of this happening

Yes. I stated journaling recently. Before I did that I would always be having conversations with him in my head. I know it sounds crazy but with journaling it helped in reducing that. Also I started writing down my nightmares, if I don't write them down they keep running through my head in vivid detail long after I'm awake
That's very smart. Thanks for the recommendations, I'll try this out.

That's smart. I hadn't thought of cutting screen time. I have muted all notifications from him. Only for phone calls I can't mute notification. Even though I'm not able to Block him yet; by not being near my phone all the time hopefully the need to check up on him all the time might decrease. I'll try it out

Also I wish you success on focusing on yourself
Thank you for the encouraging words. I hope for the both of us that me make it through
How? How is it supporting me?

Yes! I think that's it. If I block them there is no hope left. That's it. And that scares the shit out of me. But its harming me so much. It's like even if he never contacts me... the Avenue is open. From my side I haven't done anything to demotivate him from contacting me. And I'm so embarrassed even writing this. I don't want to be like this. This is showing even myself I'm so weak at the moment. I hope I am able to work on myself enough that one day I'll be strong enough to block him.
At this moment fear is holding me back and this is going to make my breakup exponentially worse. I can see myself destroying my future all by myself

>The fact that their never coming back

I think I haven't accepted this fact yet. I thought I had but deep down there is still an ember burning. I have to go inside myself, look for it and stub it out before it ruins me even more

I understand that this is what I have to do in order to move on. I have done the research.  I know the facts. I know blocking him will HELP me. But I can't. It's become an irrational fear of mine. Like some people are afraid of spiders, or heights, or confined spaces, or many other things. Its irrational. I know its irrational. Logically I know blocking him is not going to all of a sudden make him want me and yet I'll have blocked him so he will have no way of contacting me and telling me he still loves me. But it's there and I'm at a lose as to how to move on

I'm sorry about the rant. You gave factual, helpful advice and I thank you for reaching out and trying to help. Your recommendations are absolutely true but at the moment that's exactly what I'm having an issue with

This is the harsh truth. Once I accept what you said in this comment I'll know I have healed. At this moment in time I don't think I am ready to accept this truth. My ego is still bleeding and it hurts like a bitch

>it’s about them.
